description.value:
A creature that fails its save against your Invasive Presence feature also becomes charmed by you for the duration that Invasive Presence remains active on it.

While it is charmed and within 100 feet of you, you and your spirit share a telepathic link with it, and, requiring no action while you remain conscious, may issue it simple general commands — such as attacking a specific foe, moving somewhere, or retrieving an object — which it does its best to carry out. Left without further orders after completing a command, it acts to defend and preserve itself as best it can.

You may also spend your action to seize total, precise control: until the end of your next turn, the creature performs only the actions you dictate and takes no action you haven't sanctioned. You may even have it use a reaction during this time, though doing so costs you your own reaction as well.
